Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Amorphizing halide cathodes (LiVCl4, LiTaOCl4) minimizes grain-boundary ion-transport barriers rather than maximizing bulk conductivity, enabling catholyte-free ASSLBs with 90 wt% CAM. This yields 75C operation (102.1 mAh g–1 at 20 mA cm–2), 16,000-cycle stability, and wide-temperature performance, establishing conformal amorphous interfaces as a new paradigm for ultrahigh-power all-solid-state lithium batteries.
